metadata.title: Clicked like I owed someone money and somehow gifted 2 free exits? Valorant aim is a scam
metadata.description:
Me: wildly flapping like I forgot which button shoots
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
How did that double hit even happen? No clue but I’ll take it
If your aim’s a chaotic mystery, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim ever just decided to go rogue mid-game!

#valorant #luckykills #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
